caption: The video showcases a flameless electric candle on a dark turned candlestick holder atop a round table against a black background, a thin power cord trailing to the right. Its translucent cylindrical body is filled with a churning stream of bubbles lit from within, while a small orange LED flame flickers at the top. The internal illumination drifts gradually from a cyan-teal glow toward a brighter blue-white glow, and the drip-shaped crown shifts from cyan to pale white-pink. The orange flame tip flickers with slight changes in shape and tilt, while the candle body stays still. Intermittent colored glints of magenta, pink and green flash within the bubble column, most noticeable from the middle onward. The reflected light pool on the tabletop changes in the same rhythm, starting cyan and turning blue-white with faint pink tints. The candle, holder and cord appear fixed, with little apparent camera motion.
